themes.name: Unhelpful support and refused refunds
themes.definition: Support that cannot resolve problems (AI chatbot loops, no human agent), refunds refused or replaced by coupons, cancellation charges.
themes.effort_reason: Needs escalation rules, staffing and a clearer refund policy.

themes.name: Late, missing or wrong orders
themes.definition: Orders that arrive very late, never arrive, arrive incomplete or wrong, or are cancelled after ordering.
themes.effort_reason: Spans riders, restaurants and dispatch, so fixes cut across operations.

themes.name: High prices and hidden charges
themes.definition: Extra charges, price mismatches with stores, hidden costs, discount codes or offers that do not apply.

themes.name: Poor food quality and safety
themes.definition: Spoiled, bad-tasting or unsafe food and poor packaging; not delivery speed.
themes.effort_reason: Needs restaurant partner audits and quality standards.

themes.name: Ordering and payment gaps
themes.definition: Missing cash on delivery, cart or login failures, no cancel option, service unavailable in the area.

themes.name: Safety and privacy concerns
themes.definition: Abusive delivery agents or misuse of customer data.

themes.name: General dissatisfaction
themes.definition: Negative views of the app or company with no specific problem named.
themes.effort_reason: Needs research to find the specific cause.

themes.name: What users like
themes.definition: Positive comments on speed, value, food, service or the app.
